explication: Proxmark is an RFID analysis and programming platform: users issue client commands or run automation, the client communicates with device firmware, and the firmware interacts with RFID tags and peripherals. The README also documents standalone modes and broad command/script functionality, reflected here as separate capabilities. Source excerpts are partial, so the graph shows only high-level documented workflow links and avoids inferring detailed module-to-module calls.
